name: Twelve-metre try1: 800 diverse missions with test7 stage3

selection.candidate_sampling: Enumerate feasible ordered cell pairs; random bearing within the corner-defined angular span; uniform start inside source/shifted-goal rectangle intersection; goal=start+12m unit bearing
selection.balancing: Fill surface-choice geometry first, then rarer categories; greedy cell coverage and category/cell diversity with seeded random tie breaks; feasible user examples attempted first; repeated cell pairs penalized
selection.geometric_category_rules: Ice >=1m and no stairs; stairs >=1m and no ice; otherwise no hazards, surface_choice if an asphalt-waypoint alternative saves >=1m rough exposure, else regular
selection.initial_yaw: Independent uniform [-pi, pi), fixed in mission file
selection.reference_note: Empty frozen twelve-metre reference; no prior twelve-metre cases selected

path_note: Geometric diversity constraints describe assigned segments, not predicted policy outcomes. All 800 outcomes must be retained.
